ASCRIBE: Atomic and Significance-Based Reasoning for Thai Clinical SOAP Note Generation

Tarm Kalavantavanich, Teerawut Ponarchar, Pattaramanee Arsomngern, Jenta Wonglertsakul, Watcharakorn Chuthong, Chiraphat Boonnag, Knot Pipatsrisawat, Titipat Achakulvisut

WiNLP @ EMNLP 2026 👑 Best Paper Award

ASCRIBE assigns clinical significance to extracted facts before generating Thai SOAP notes. The work also introduces ThaiClinicBench and a synthetic training corpus for evaluating and training clinical summarization systems. (Worked as a project leader)

Zero-shot Inexact CAD Model Alignment from a Single Image

Pattaramanee Arsomngern, Sasikarn Khwanmuang, Matthias Nießner, Supasorn Suwajanakorn

International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV) 2025

We introduce a weakly supervised method for aligning inexact 3D CAD models to a single image without pose annotations. The method generalizes to unseen object categories and achieves state-of-the-art results on real-world alignment benchmarks.

Learning Geometric-Aware Properties in 2D Representation Using Lightweight CAD Models, or Zero Real 3D Pairs

Pattaramanee Arsomngern, Sarana Nutanong, Supasorn Suwajanakorn

IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) 2023

We use lightweight CAD models to transfer geometric information into 2D image representations, improving downstream scene understanding without relying on large 3D scene datasets. The method also learns from generated image-CAD pairs and achieves competitive results across several 2D understanding tasks.

Towards Pointsets Representation Learning via Self-Supervised Learning and Set Augmentation

Pattaramanee Arsomngern, Cheng Long, Supasorn Suwajanakorn, Sarana Nutanong

IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence 2023

We propose a self-supervised deep metric learning method for pointsets, using Earth Mover’s Distance to generate pseudo-labels and a pointset augmentation method. The learned representations improve performance on unsupervised tasks and can be fine-tuned for downstream applications.

2021

Self-Supervised Deep Metric Learning for Pointsets

Pattaramanee Arsomngern, Cheng Long, Supasorn Suwajanakorn, Sarana Nutanong

IEEE International Conference on Data Engineering (ICDE) 2021

We introduce a self-supervised deep metric learning method for pointsets that uses Earth Mover’s Distance to create pseudo-labels, along with a transfer learning strategy for small datasets. The approach learns useful representations without labeled training data.
